title: Ship Navigator

startNotice.title: For learning only
startNotice.text: This role is **arithmetic practice only**. All vessels, places and figures are made up. It is **not for real navigation**, which needs official charts and tide tables, the rules of the road at sea, proper training and a certificate of competency.

description: Passage time and fuel, set and drift, the rule of twelfths for tides and under-keel clearance, and closest approach of two ships: navigation arithmetic worked from the figures, with every rule stated.
